papers.title: Learning high-accuracy error decoding for quantum processors
papers.task_relation: The local task predicts logical outcomes from complete experimental syndrome shots. Its three X-basis acquisitions and shot-level score are a restricted local evaluation, not the paper's complete decoder architecture or experimental programme.
papers.primary_goal: Improve surface-code decoding accuracy on experimental quantum-processor data and realistic simulations.

science_relevance.scientific_problem: Decode measured surface-code syndromes to reduce logical errors in quantum memories.
science_relevance.importance_rationale: Inferring logical corrections from noisy experimental syndromes is the direct error-correction problem addressed by the paper.
science_relevance.reason: The paper attempts to solve physical error decoding; its learned architecture is the means of solving that problem.
